name: Tyrannosaurus Rex Skull
funFact: T-Rex had forward-facing eyes, giving it excellent depth perception for hunting!

name: Triceratops Horn
funFact: Each horn could be up to 3 feet long — longer than a baseball bat!

name: Raptor Claw
funFact: The sickle-shaped claw was used for pinning down prey, not slashing!

name: Stegosaurus Plate
funFact: The plates weren't attached to the skeleton — they grew in the skin!

name: Sauropod Vertebra
funFact: A single neck vertebra could be over 3 feet long!

name: Pteranodon Wing Bone
funFact: Despite its huge wingspan, Pteranodon only weighed about 55 pounds!

name: Ankylosaur Tail Club
funFact: The tail club was made of fused bones and could swing with 500 pounds of force!

name: Dinosaur Egg
funFact: Oviraptor means 'egg thief' but it was actually protecting its OWN eggs!
